purpose: Publish a reviewable current-state snapshot, not approval to execute Native MPC.

native_caller_independent_review.B2: Body traffic can increment ledger counters; the caller incorrectly requires zero. A telemetry error can also mask the separate post-GPU idle assertion.
native_caller_independent_review.B3: The caller counts planned episode requests as offered before run entry and lacks caller-owned durable not-run accounting on early failure.
native_caller_independent_review.next: Implement narrow corrections, pass focused regressions and diff-only independent acceptance, then separately preregister the five-request Native qualification.

draft_regression_evidence.first_generation: 4 failed, 12 passed, 2 subtests passed. The idle test incorrectly made the pre-start GPU non-idle, so that failure did not witness the intended post-cleanup assertion.
draft_regression_evidence.corrected_generation: 4 failed, 12 passed, 2 subtests passed. The fixture now preserves idle startup and makes only the post-cleanup GPU non-idle; B2 and B3 failures reproduce.
draft_regression_evidence.source_changes: NONE. Draft changes are retained as patches, not active failing regression files. Existing accepted test bytes are preserved.

publication_policy.format: Draft PR from main containing current code, P0 evidence, and directly cited historical audits.
publication_policy.reason: Original research branch contains 674 commits, about 6.5 GB and blobs exceeding the GitHub 100 MiB limit.
publication_policy.not_included: Entire research history, unrelated sampling campaigns, model weights, personal resume/contact details and unrelated untracked agent work.
publication_policy.provenance: Original local source commits remain provenance metadata, not reachable commits in the snapshot PR. Exported bytes are hash-bound by the publication manifest; the new PR commit is the public snapshot identity.
